================================================================================
  WORKFLOW SPECIFICATIONS
================================================================================

1. CI WORKFLOW (ci.yml)
   Purpose: Run tests and checks on every push/PR
   Triggers: Push to main/develop, all PRs
   Duration: 10-15 minutes
   Jobs:
   - Lint & Type Check (2-3 min)
   - Tests (5-8 min)
   - Build (5-10 min)
   - CI Summary
   Features:
   - Fail-fast strategy
   - Concurrency control
   - Step summaries

2. BUILD & PUSH WORKFLOW (build-and-push.yml)
   Purpose: Build and push Docker images
   Triggers: Push to main, manual dispatch
   Duration: 20-30 minutes
   Jobs:
   - Prepare Build Context
   - Build & Push (3 image variants)
   Features:
   - Multi-image builds
   - Layer caching
   - GHCR.io registry
   - Semantic versioning support

3. DEPLOY WORKFLOW (deploy.yml)
   Purpose: Deploy to production server
   Triggers: Push to main, manual dispatch
   Duration: 10-15 minutes
   Jobs:
   - Validate
   - Deploy (SSH-based)
   - Health Check
   - Post-Deploy
   Features:
   - SSH-based deployment
   - Health checks
   - Pre-deployment validation
   - Deployment reporting

4. SECURITY WORKFLOW (security.yml)
   Purpose: Security scanning and vulnerability detection
   Triggers: Push, PR, daily schedule (2 AM UTC)
   Duration: 20-30 minutes
   Jobs:
   - Dependency Check (npm audit)
   - CodeQL Analysis
   - SAST Scanning (Semgrep)
   - Container Scan (Trivy)
   - License Check
   - Security Summary

5. RELEASE WORKFLOW (release.yml)
   Purpose: Create versioned releases
   Triggers: Manual (Actions tab)
   Duration: 30-40 minutes
   Jobs:
   - Validate Release
   - Test (full CI pipeline)
   - Create Release
   - Docker Release
   - Release Summary
   Features:
   - Semantic versioning
   - Git tags
   - GitHub Releases
   - Versioned Docker images

================================================================================
  KEY FEATURES
================================================================================

✓ Fail-Fast Strategy
  - Linting runs first
  - Blocks subsequent jobs on failure
  - Saves time and resources

✓ Comprehensive Testing
  - ESLint for code quality
  - TypeScript for type safety
  - Vitest for unit tests
  - Full application build verification

✓ Docker Optimization
  - Multi-stage builds
  - Layer caching via BuildKit
  - GitHub Actions cache
  - Three image variants (main, frontend, backend)

✓ Production Ready
  - SSH-based deployment
  - Health checks before completion
  - Environment secret management
  - Automatic rollback via git revert

✓ Security First
  - npm audit
  - CodeQL analysis
  - Semgrep SAST
  - Trivy container scanning
  - License compliance
  - Daily automated scans

✓ Clear Feedback
  - GitHub step summaries
  - Detailed error messages
  - Job status reports
  - Deployment notifications

✓ Concurrency Control
  - Cancels previous runs on new push
  - Prevents resource waste
  - Ensures clean workflow state

================================================================================
  CONFIGURATION REQUIREMENTS
================================================================================

MINIMAL SETUP (CI only):
1. Enable GitHub Actions: Settings → Actions → Allow all actions
2. Push to main branch
3. Workflows run automatically

PRODUCTION SETUP (add deployment):
1. Generate SSH key pair (ssh-keygen)
2. Add 3 GitHub Secrets:
   - DEPLOY_KEY (private key)
   - DEPLOY_HOST (server hostname)
   - DEPLOY_USER (SSH username)
3. Configure production server (see DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md)
4. Test SSH connectivity

BRANCH PROTECTION (recommended):
1. Settings → Branches → Add rule for main
2. Require status checks: CI, Tests, Build
3. Require PR reviews
4. Dismiss stale approvals on new commits

================================================================================
  DOCKER REGISTRY
================================================================================

Registry: GitHub Container Registry (ghcr.io)
Repository: ghcr.io/OWNER/voxmation

Image Tags:
- latest          (main branch production image)
- main-latest     (main branch ref)
- frontend-latest (frontend image)
- backend-latest  (backend image)
- v1.0.0          (semantic version)
- main-abc123     (SHA-based)

Requires:
- GITHUB_TOKEN (automatically provided)
- OR personal access token with packages:write

  EXECUTION PIPELINE
================================================================================

Typical flow (all features enabled):

Developer pushes to main
    ↓
CI Workflow (lint, test, build) - 10-15 min
    ↓
    ├─→ Build & Push (Docker) - 20-30 min (parallel)
    └─→ Security Scan - 20-30 min (parallel)
    ↓
Deploy Workflow (SSH, health checks) - 10-15 min
    ↓
Production running latest code ✓

Total time: 35-50 minutes typical
With caching: 25-35 minutes

================================================================================
  SUPPORT & TROUBLESHOOTING
================================================================================

Issue: Workflows won't start
Solution: Check GitHub Actions is enabled (Settings → Actions)

Issue: Tests failing in CI but passing locally
Solution: Run 'npm ci' locally to match CI environment

Issue: Docker build timeout
Solution: Increase timeout-minutes in workflow (line ~45)

Issue: Deployment fails with SSH error
Solution: Verify DEPLOY_KEY and DEPLOY_HOST secrets are correct

Issue: Container health check fails
Solution: SSH to server and check 'docker logs container-name'

For more: See .github/WORKFLOWS.md Troubleshooting section
